text: Prof. Jie Fan is the team’s PI at Nankai University. Her research explores microbial secondary metabolism, interactions between species, and synthetic biology. She helps the team turn biological questions into workable engineering ideas, offering guidance from experimental design to the way the team shares its findings.

Ruoxi mainly works on dry lab and, as team leader, helps connect people, coordinate work, and keep things moving. Outside iGEM, her interests span art, music, and film. She enjoys exploring different forms of expression, unpacking song lyrics, and occasionally taking a closer look at birth charts.
Team Coordination · Experimental Design · Wet Lab

Xinya enjoys both a good hiking trail and a quiet afternoon with a book. Meticulous, resilient, and responsible, she brings a steady approach to everyday challenges. Yogurt and dried cranberries are her favorite treats, and the red panda is her animal of choice.

Feiyue enjoys basketball, exploring open-source tools, and figuring out how things work. Patient and attentive to detail, Feiyue likes taking the time to work through a question properly. Dark chocolate and black coffee are favorite companions, with the owl as a personal mascot.

Chang is a nature enthusiast with a particular fondness for arthropods. Full of wandering ideas, sudden bursts of enthusiasm, and good humor, Chang enjoys drawing, reading, and rolling d20s in dungeons. Occasionally, being a moth sounds like a perfectly reasonable alternative.

Chang is a nature enthusiast with a particular fondness for arthropods. Full of wandering ideas, sudden bursts of enthusiasm, and good humor, Chang enjoys drawing, reading, and rolling d20s in dungeons. Occasionally, being a moth sounds like a perfectly reasonable alternative.

Shizhao has wide-ranging interests and self-described “Schrödinger-like” energy levels. A longtime football enthusiast, he also enjoys table tennis, roller skating, and volleyball. His musical tastes span erhu and, lately, old Cantonese songs. His quirky ideas bring the team plenty of surprises—and the occasional puzzled look.

Yifei, also known as Ivy, enjoys sports, traveling, and meeting new people. Open-minded and energetic, Ivy is always happy to explore an unfamiliar place or make a new connection. An energy bar and orange juice are the go-to combination.

Yinzi may take a little time to warm up, but is easygoing once comfortable. Video games are a favorite pastime, alongside table tennis, badminton, and music. The meeting of biology and engineering sparked Yinzi’s interest in synthetic biology, with plenty more still to explore.

Hongbo is a PhD student returning for a second iGEM season. Collaborative and proactive, Hongbo brings experience in early project design and a willingness to join the discussion. Away from research, volleyball and growing plants offer two different ways to practice patience and teamwork.

Hongbo is a PhD student returning for a second iGEM season. Collaborative and proactive, Hongbo brings experience in early project design and a willingness to join the discussion. Away from research, volleyball and growing plants offer two different ways to practice patience and teamwork.

Yuanwen enjoys making crafts, trying different foods, and learning something new. Curious and attentive to detail, Yuanwen is equally happy creating something by hand or exchanging ideas with others. There is always another craft to try or a new dish to discover.

Qinghua loves wandering outdoors and noticing the tiny creatures others might walk past. Warm, proactive, and curious about the natural world, Qinghua finds plenty to admire in living things. Lemon candy and oolong tea round out the list of favorites.

Ziyi studies Biological Sciences in Nankai’s Boling Class and is a keen Minecraft player helping build the campus MC club. Beyond biology, Ziyi enjoys sweets, music, and playing different instruments. iGEM offers another welcome opportunity to meet people who share that enthusiasm for science.

Zhiyuan likes exploring unfamiliar subjects and giving new things a try. Psychology books and novels are particular favorites, alongside a growing collection of hobbies. Rather than claiming expertise in all of them, Zhiyuan is happy to be a curious beginner with another question to ask.

Yanmei enjoys science-fiction films and bringing imaginative ideas to life through painting. Science and art both offer room to explore whatever catches Yanmei’s curiosity. Analytical, creative, and fond of collaboration, Yanmei enjoys sharing ideas and working through them with others.

Shulan is a longtime volleyball fan who would happily spend more time on the court. A food lover and enthusiastic city walker, Shulan also enjoys discovering unfamiliar streets and something delicious along the way. Potato chips remain a reliable favorite.

Xinqi enjoys novels and jogging, making room for both imagined worlds and time outdoors. Calm and thoughtful, Xinqi values the friendships formed with teammates. Milk tea and mixed nuts are favorite treats, and the sea turtle is the animal Xinqi identifies with most.

Peisong leads the Human Practices team and is a master’s student in Biology and Medicine at Nankai University. Bringing that background into conversations beyond the lab, Peisong works to connect the team’s research with societal needs and encourage dialogue with the wider community.

Kaiben is optimistic, enthusiastic about volunteering, and happiest to bring people together. A curiosity about others and an interest in sharing science make conversations with people of different ages and backgrounds especially rewarding. Community activities offer plenty of opportunities to do both.

Xinyu enjoys illustration, nature, and making things by hand. Working across Human Practices and visual design, Xinyu turns complex scientific ideas into approachable images and outreach materials. Careful attention to detail supports a simple aim: making science easier for more people to connect with.

Xinying’s love of both biology and art brought them to the team. Writing, photography, and music fill much of their free time. They may seem quiet at first, but have a lively inner world and look forward to meeting people with different stories and perspectives.

For Yuxin, music and images belong together. Anime music, singing, and making MAD edits in Adobe After Effects are favorite ways to spend free time. Gentle and optimistic, Yuxin enjoys capturing everyday moments and finding ways to tell stories through them.

Jiarui is a computer science student and self-described night owl who enjoys trying AI tools and playing Valorant. Waking up, Jiarui jokes, is much harder than falling asleep. Salted chips are a favorite snack, and a dog would be the chosen animal counterpart.

Dr. Penglin Wei is a postdoctoral researcher at Nankai University, working on filamentous fungal cell factories for secondary metabolite production. As an advisor, he supports both dry-lab and wet-lab research, helping the team sharpen its ideas and work through experimental design.

Zhiyi, also known as Churchill, returns as an advisor after leading NKU-China 2025. Warm, open, and always ready for a conversation, he now shares lessons from the previous season while learning from the new team. His fascination with life and the possibilities of studying it remains unchanged.

Zhanning, also known as Roy, helps coordinate the team’s dry-lab research, particularly molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. He works with members to refine computational approaches and tackle questions in modeling and analysis, helping the team make sense of what the calculations reveal.

Ruitong studies Visual Communication Design at Xiamen University. She enjoys getting lost in words and films—or simply letting her mind wander. Patient and approachable, she likes exchanging ideas, then giving those unexpected turns of imagination a clear visual form.

Yiling studies Digital Interaction at the China Academy of Art and enjoys exploring how visuals and interactive experiences communicate ideas. Thoughtful and attentive to detail, Yiling brings enthusiasm to collaborative work and welcomes the chance to learn from people beyond the design world.
